period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December audited position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (the filing's own header reads 'FOR THE 2ND QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2012' but the single column of figures is the 6-month Jan-Jun cumulative, confirmed by cross-check against quarterly/2012_Q3.json: this quarter's net_profit_after_tax_cumulative of 704.56m plus an incremental Q3-quarter profit of 345.48m sums to 2012_Q3.json's cumulative 1050.04m -- consistent with strictly cumulative reporting and no double-counting), as published in the bank's own unaudited 'BALANCE SHEET' and 'PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT' (then filed as Mercantile Bank Limited, pre-PLC conversion) for the period ended 30 June 2012. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'MERCANTILE BANK LIMITED' with no 'AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES'/'CONSOLIDATED' qualifier, consistent with this bank's established reporting_basis in sources.json). Fully manually cross-checked against every internal subtotal: balance-sheet identity (Total Assets 136,839,813,587 = sum of the 7 asset lines, ties exactly; Total Liabilities 126,604,378,121 = Borrowings + Deposits + Other Liabilities, ties exactly; Total Equity 10,235,435,466 = Paid-up Capital + Statutory Reserve + Other Reserve + Surplus in P&L, ties exactly; Total Liabilities + Equity = Total Assets exactly), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income, ties exactly), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain (Total Operating Expenses, Profit before Provision, Total Provision -- itself the sum of Classified + Unclassified + Other provision -- Total Profit before Taxes, and Net Profit after Taxation all tie exactly), the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Statutory Reserve appropriation + Retained Surplus c/f, ties exactly and the Retained Surplus c/f figure of 599,236,081 matches the Balance Sheet's own 'Surplus in Profit & Loss Account' line exactly), and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value) = 1.153, matches the reported 1.15). Zero discrepancies found anywhere in this document. Source was two separate single-statement PDFs (Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account) rather than one combined filing, the format mblbd.com used in 2011-2013; a Cash Flow Statement PDF also exists for this period but was not needed for these line items. No Off-Balance-Sheet-exposures figure was published as a separate PDF for this period, so that field is left out rather than estimated.
